title: committed coap/l2 sources incompatible with Zephyr 4.1.0 workspace
description: Full compile of the coap subsystem against the local 4.1.0 Zephyr workspace (not the pinned v3.7.0) fails in files untouched by the o287 revert: (a) coap_client.c:180/:191 'struct coap_client has no member send_mutex' (Zephyr 4.x removed it); (b) lichen_util.c:16 vs lichen_util.h:70 -Werror=array-parameter (uint8_t* vs uint8_t[32]). Version-split only: CI/AWS builder uses pinned v3.7.0 where they compile. Either fix sources for both versions or document 4.1.0-workspace builds unsupported for those files. Discovered during o287 generate proof; generate itself passes.
